candidate_execution_fields.interpretation: candidate ledger records pre-outcome contact admission; formal teacher completion is represented only by checkpoint status

scope.inferential_rule: KS, discrepancy, and rank correlation are randomized-QMC design diagnostics; no iid p-values are reported
scope.population: pre-outcome design and S-CONTACT formal-input population
scope.sealed_test_policy: test inputs may be audited; teacher results remain sealed

design_weight.weight_meaning: inverse inclusion probability for candidates drawn directly from p0

reported.evidence_boundary: These diagnostics validate the sampling design and weights only; they do not validate damage physics or real-world label accuracy.
